title: Equal Dose, Different Coverage:Tracing Rate and Duration in Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.19955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Benchmarks for scientific image editing test whether a model draws the outcome of a described process, leaving open which representations carry its errors and whether correcting them yields the right quantity. We study this question with an airbrush of fixed deposition profile, under which exchanging rate and duration preserves the dose and should preserve the endpoint, yet changes the edited coverage. Matched-norm activation patches across text positions and denoising stages show that, in distilled FLUX with Chinese prompts, representations at unchanged text positions (context) carry this discrepancy: early context transfers 3.51 of the 3.98 percentage-point (pp) signed route difference, against 0.09 pp for equal-norm updates at the two changed digits. translated_title: 相同剂量，不同覆盖：追踪图像编辑中的速率与时长
translated_abstract: 科学图像编辑基准测试检验模型能否描绘出所述过程的结果，但留下了两个未解问题：哪些表示承载了模型的错误，以及纠正这些错误能否得到正确的量。我们使用具有固定沉积轮廓的喷枪来研究这一问题：在该条件下，交换速率与时长会保持剂量不变，理应保持终点结果不变，然而却改变了编辑后的覆盖范围。跨文本位置与去噪阶段的等范数激活补丁实验表明，在使用中文提示词的蒸馏版FLUX中，未改变的文本位置（上下文）处的表示承载了这一差异：早期上下文传递了3.98个百分点（pp）带符号路径差异中的3.51 pp，而两个被改变数字处的等范数更新仅传递0.09 pp。早期图像潜变量在两种FLUX配置和OmniGen中传递原始（未修补）的路径差异，而文本位置效应则依赖于具体配置。该轨迹预测了…
tldr: 该论文通过固定剂量喷枪实验（交换速率与时长虽保持剂量不变却改变编辑覆盖范围）追踪图像编辑模型的错误来源，发现早期上下文表示承载了主要差异，而早期图像潜变量则在多个模型配置中传递原始差异。
en_tdlr: Using a fixed-dose airbrush scenario where swapping rate and duration preserves dose yet alters edited coverage, this work traces image-editing errors to early context representations at unchanged text positions in distilled FLUX (Chinese prompts), while early image latents transmit native route differences across FLUX configurations and OmniGen.
